description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Al Bhed, Int 15

Benefit: You may create magic items without the requisite item creation feat from the list below when your ranks in Spellcraft reach the sufficient number, using your ranks in Spellcraft as your Caster Level, though this increases the DC of crafting by +10. 1 Rank - Scribe Scroll. 3 Ranks - Craft Alchemical Item, Craft Wondrous Item. 5 Ranks - Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Materia, Craft Wand. 7 Ranks - Forge Ring. 9 Ranks - Craft Rod. 11 Ranks - Craft Staff.
